primary_counters: Pikemen / Halberdiers (+22 / +32 bonus damage vs cavalry)
cavalry.micro_tactics: Bait pikemen away before diving siege engines. Upgrade Scale/Chain Barding Armor before diving into archer balls.

primary_counters: Elite Skirmishers (+4 bonus damage vs archers, high pierce armor)
countered_by: Pikemen / Spearmen (deal almost zero damage to archers)
archers.micro_tactics: Use Stand Ground stance and split formation ('X' key) when enemy mangonels fire. Keep a 5-6 spearman screen to prevent knight dives.

primary_counters: Villager pull (villagers get bonus damage vs siege)
siege.micro_tactics: Attack ground with mangonels on predictable archer movement paths.

trash_wars.mechanics: Hussars counter Skirmishers; Skirmishers counter Halberdiers; Halberdiers counter Hussars.
trash_wars.macro_rule: Sustain 60+ farms and 40+ trade carts in Imperial Age. Add 10-15 barracks and stables so reinforcements out-produce enemy casualties.
